versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-cdn-origin-diagnosis skill.
- Diagnose CDN origin server reachability and back-to-source failures using hcloud CLI and a Python probe script.
- Automatically queries and parses CDN origin configuration (origin_addr, origin_type, http_port, https_port, origin_protocol).
- Probes origin server connectivity for HTTP, HTTPS, or follow protocol and generates structured diagnosis reports.
- Strictly read-only: all write/modify/delete CDN operations (total 55) are prohibited for security.
